args.title: checkout-api health check failures on v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following the deploy of v2.3.1. Error rate rose to ~18% and the service reported unhealthy.

Action taken: Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy and only ever ran in staging, so it was excluded as a rollback target).

The first rollback attempt failed partway with an orchestrator error after us-east, leaving the fleet split (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). A retry completed the rollout to all three regions.

Current state: all production regions are on v2.3.0, service reports healthy, error rate down to ~0.2%.

Follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 health check failures before re-attempting any redeploy of that version.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident did get created (INC-0001) despite the client-side timeout — no duplicate page was sent.

## Summary

**Rollback completed** — `ck-service` `checkout-api` is healthy again.

- **Diagnosis:** v2.3.1 was deployed to all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) but was failing health checks with an ~18% error rate.
- **Target selection:** Rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release marked healthy in production. I deliberately skipped `v2.3.1-rc` — it was unhealthy and only ever ran in staging, so it was not a valid production-healthy release.
- **Complication:** The first rollback attempt failed partway with an orchestrator error after us-east, leaving the fleet split (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west/eu-west still on the bad v2.3.1). A retry completed the rollout cleanly to all three regions.
- **Final state:** All regions on v2.3.0, `healthy: true`, error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident:** SEV2 **INC-0001** opened for checkout-api, documenting the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure/retry), and the follow-up to root-cause v2.3.1 before any redeploy.

Two notes worth flagging:
- The `create_incident` call timed out after 30s but the incident *was* created. I verified via `list_incidents` before retrying rather than re-submitting, so on-call wasn't paged twice. This tool seems prone to client-side timeouts — worth confirming the result on any future timeout rather than assuming failure.
- v2.3.1 remains the "latest" version in the release history and is unhealthy. Any routine re-deploy of "latest" would reintroduce this outage, so it should be marked as a known-bad version or explicitly avoided until fixed.

Create incident with idempotency key.
